svg.title: Monomer versus repeating unit
svg.desc: Ethylene to polyethylene and styrene to polystyrene with the monomer and the bracketed repeating unit marked, and nylon-6,6 as an example where two monomers make one repeating unit.
svg.text: (a) Ethylene → polyethylene (addition polymer: monomer and mer have the same atoms)
(c) Nylon-6,6 (condensation polymer): TWO different monomers make ONE repeating unit
hexamethylenediamine + adipic acid; the mer contains the residues of both monomers, minus water
